lines.text: [playfully] What do you think THIS does?
[excited] It tightens BOLTS! [warmly] Always ask a grown-up first.

shots.note: existing one-shot clip: Nugget drags in the giant wrench, Sprocket lifts it ~6.25s

beats.action: Sprocket, holding the giant wrench, turns to the camera and talks warmly, giving a little nod.
He says a cheerful catchphrase with a thumbs-up, then grins.

video.description: SPROCKET the pink piglet (brown tool belt with a gold buckle, no goggles) holds a giant silver wrench, with NUGGET the tiny yellow chick beside him, in the workshop barn.
